name: Hotel Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu
insider_take: This grand château-style resort perched dramatically above the St. Lawrence River has been the playground of royalty and presidents since 1899, offering old-world elegance with breathtaking Charlevoix wilderness as your backdrop.
whats_special: The hotel sits on a UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve where the Canadian Shield meets the sea, creating unique landscapes found nowhere else. The property features its own championship golf course designed by Herbert Strong and a casino with stunning river views. La Malbaie was also designated as the G7 Summit location in 2018, cementing its status as a world-class destination.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on the upper floors for spectacular sunrise views over the St. Lawrence, and time your visit during fall foliage season when the Charlevoix region transforms into a tapestry of brilliant reds and golds.
dont_miss: Take the scenic Route du Fleuve drive to nearby Baie-Saint-Paul, a charming artist village, or experience whale watching from Tadoussac, just 45 minutes away where the Saguenay Fjord meets the St. Lawrence River - one of the world's best beluga whale viewing spots.
pros: Historic château-style architecture with stunning St. Lawrence River views
World-class golf course and comprehensive spa facilities
Prime location in Charlevoix UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
Exceptional fine dining with locally-sourced Quebec cuisine
cons: Remote location requires longer travel time from major cities
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive amenities
